description: Stormcaller's Hauberk Level 60 Bring the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of the Sage, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest. Requirements: - Carapace of the Old God - Idol of the Sage x 2 - Silver Scarab x 5 - Bone Scarab x 5 - Brood of Nozdormu:
name: Stormcaller's Hauberk
